title: 第3章 多子多福系统
slug: 班级地铁求生全班就我一个男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“站头尽头有洗手间标志，那里应该有洗手间！”

凌云指了指站台深处。

“谁陪青青一起深入站台？”

陆小小第一个举手。

“我陪青青姐去。”

姜瑶看了一眼她那被比基尼勒得紧绷的汹涌。

果断否定道。

“不行，万一遇到危险，你跑不快！”

质量越大，阻力越大。

很快，众人的目光又汇聚到秦守身上。

秦守是唯一的男生。

护卫的事情，大家自然而然想到他。

陆小小说道。

“秦守，你陪青青姐一起深入吧！”

这叫什么话，听起来怪怪的！

秦守看了一眼苏青青。

苏青青咬着下唇，锁骨窝里积了一小片汗，在日光灯下亮晶晶的，小腹微微收紧——不是故意的，是憋的。

她真的快到极限了！

秦守平时与苏青青关系不错。

秦守微微叹了一口气，说道：“好，我陪青青同学一起深入……嗯，一起去！”

苏青青感激地道：“秦守同学，谢谢你……”

说着，她的声音小了下去。她察觉到了一个尴尬的问题。

秦守没穿衣服。

她穿着比基尼。

他们要一起去上厕所……

苏青青的脸颊从颧骨一路红到耳根，连比基尼上缘的皮肤都染上了粉色。

她张了张嘴，想说“还是算了”，但小腹一阵收紧，脚趾蜷曲着扣住地砖，那个“算”字被硬生生憋了回去。

“走吧。”

秦守准备护送苏青青上厕所。

“等一下。”

姜瑶的声音从旁边传来。

她走到秦守面前。

火辣的比基尼穿在美女班长身上，锁骨平直，腰线流畅。

她没有看秦守的身体——目光精准地定在他脸上，纹丝不动。

但她的耳尖是红的。

“你一个人陪她去，不方便。”

“哪里不方便？”陆小小从后面探出头。

“他是男生……青青是女生……厕所……”

姜瑶说了三个词，每个词之间停顿了半秒。

车厢里安静了一瞬。

然后陆小小“哦”了一声，缩回去了。

那个“哦”拉得很长，意味深长。

秦守假装没听见，问道：“那怎么办？”

“我陪你们去。”

"There is a restroom sign at the end of the station, there should be a restroom there!"

Ling Yun pointed deep into the platform.

"Who will accompany Qingqing deep into the platform?"

Lu Xiaoxiao was the first to raise his hand.

"I'll accompany Sister Qingqing."

Jiang Yao took a look at her body that was stretched tight by her bikini.

He decisively denied it.

"No, if you encounter danger, you can't run fast!"

The greater the mass, the greater the resistance.

Soon, everyone's eyes focused on Qin Shou again.

Qin Shou is the only boy.

When it comes to guarding, everyone naturally thinks of him.

Lu Xiaoxiao said.

"Qin Shou, please go deeper with Sister Qingqing!"

What do you call this? It sounds weird!

Qin Shou glanced at Su Qingqing.

Su Qingqing bit her lower lip. A small patch of sweat accumulated in her clavicle, which was glistening under the fluorescent lamp. Her lower abdomen tightened slightly - not intentionally, but suppressed.

She is really at her limit!

Qin Shou usually has a good relationship with Su Qingqing.

Qin Shou sighed slightly and said, "Okay, I'll go deep with Qingqing... Well, let's go together!"

Su Qingqing said gratefully: "Classmate Qin Shou, thank you..."

As she spoke, her voice softened.She noticed an awkward question.

Qin Shou had no clothes on.

She is wearing a bikini.

They have to go to the toilet together...

Su Qingqing's cheeks were red from her cheekbones to her ears, and even the skin on the upper edge of her bikini was dyed pink.

She opened her mouth, wanting to say "forget it", but her lower abdomen tightened, her toes curled up and pressed against the floor tiles, and the word "forget" was forced back.

"Let's go."

Qin Shou prepared to escort Su Qingqing to the toilet.

"Wait a minute."

Jiang Yao's voice came from the side.

She walked up to Qin Shou.

The hot bikini is worn on the beautiful squad leader, with straight collarbones and smooth waistline.

She didn't look at Qin Shou's body - her eyes were fixed on his face precisely, not moving at all.

But the tips of her ears are red.

"It's inconvenient for you to accompany her alone."

"What's inconvenient?" Lu Xiaoxiao stuck his head out from behind.

"He is a boy...Qingqing is a girl...the toilet..."

Jiang Yao said three words, pausing for half a second between each word.

The car was quiet for a moment.

Then Lu Xiaoxiao said "Oh" and shrank back.

That "oh" is very long and meaningful.

Qin Shou pretended not to hear and asked, "What should we do?"

"I'll go with you."
